absences.approvalToggleDescription: When enabled, pending absences render hollow in the calendar and the approval column mapping becomes required
absences.rejectedLabelsDescription: Requests with these labels are not shown in the calendar. An approval label assigned to no group is reported as a configuration error

welcome.label: Welcome

welcome.lede: Three quick questions and we'll set up everything you need — boards, columns, and sample data. You can change anything later from Settings.
